summary: Made the two dev-mode email tests HERMETIC and green. Implemented the documented DEV-stdout delivery tier in email.go: SendVerificationCode/SendInvitationEmail, when smtpHost=='' && client==nil, log a developer-visibility line with the secret scrubbed through the shared redact.Text library (produces [REDACTED CREDENTIAL]) and return nil (previously returned ErrEmailBackendNotConfigured). Tests require no SMTP/Resend backend or secrets; invitation test pins FRONTEND_ORIGIN via t.Setenv to remove the only ambient-env read.
non_claims: no live run / no inference / no secret read
go vet/test fetched already-declared modules into the cache to build; go.mod/go.sum UNCHANGED (no new dependency added)
ErrEmailBackendNotConfigured retained as exported var (now unused internally; API preserved) — grep confirmed zero external callers/asserts before change
did not hard-code the [REDACTED CREDENTIAL] literal; it is produced by pkg/redact (single source of truth)
behavior_change_note: no-backend path now logs-redacted + returns nil (documented 'DEV stdout' tier) instead of ErrEmailBackendNotConfigured; safe because that error had no external consumers (verified by repo-wide grep).
